answer:
I rebuilt the Meal plan app on its App side, and it no longer scrolls sideways on a phone. The automated layout check came back clean at phone, tablet and desktop widths. I haven't looked at it on your iPhone.

The old version forced the table to be 900 px wide. Each day is now its own card. Breakfast, lunch, dinner and snack are listed inside it, and your note for the day sits underneath. Days with Shop = Yes get a "Shop" badge. Today's card (Monday) is outlined and marked "today". On wider screens the cards sit in 2 or 3 columns.

The note's text and table are unchanged, so edits there still show up in the app.
